finalModelMessage:
I could not complete registration, so there is no confirmation code.

What stopped me:
- On `/inaccessible`, the workshop listing for **Building Accessible Forms in Java** does not expose a usable Register control (not a named button or link). I only reached the form by going to `/inaccessible/register/accessible-forms`.
- On the form I set name **Jordan Lee**, first submitted with **jordan-not-an-email** (no validation error appeared in the accessibility tree), then corrected the email to **jordan.lee@example.com** and accepted terms via the unlabeled checkbox.
- I could not select a meal preference. It is only static text “Meal preference…” — not a combobox, listbox, or labeled select — so every attempt to choose an option timed out.
- Clicking **Complete registration** after that still left me on the same form with no confirmation.
